name: Scott Gaspard
bio:
Scott Gaspard has been selling real estate in south Louisiana since 1998, serving more than 1,000 clients, and has been recognized as a top-producing agent eleven times since 2013. In 2026 he founded Gaspard & Co Real Estate, bringing together some of the area's most experienced agents under one roof.

Scott's clients know what to expect: a home priced right, marketed well, and a clear update at every stage. That consistency has earned more than 350 five-star reviews on Zillow and Google.

Scott and his wife Jessica have 13 children, and he brings that same family-first approach to every client he works with.

reviews.quote: We have worked with Scott to buy and sell several properties. We keep using Scott because he is great at what he does. Trust is a big factor in choosing and working with a real estate agent and we trust Scott implicitly. He knows the market, helped us understand what was available at different price points in the different areas of Baton Rouge, and worked effectively to meet our timing requirements. He also has a great network of resources to help get properties ready or to make repairs or changes to purchased properties. If you are looking to buy or sell, I highly recommend Scott Gaspard and his team
